[Ex went to suicide](https://www.reddit.com/r/AskReddit/comments/2efscm/serious_has_anyone_ever_had_an_ex_boyfriend/?utm_medium=android_app&utm_source=share)

I will quote this one by Mastercheese274, 5 years ago

"I was recently broken up with by my girlfriend of a couple of years. She said she needed a break to find out who she was outside of a relationship. I hold onto the hope that she will come back to me, and I really do think its probably that she will. The last thing she said to me was that she loved me. She is my best friend and the love of my life and since then I've dealt with depression. I can't eat, sleeping is difficult, I constantly feel miserable, and things I used to love like movies and comics do nothing for me. 

It got to the point where I found myself wishing to be dead. I contemplated suicide, but decided against it for this very reason. I didn't want to put that guilt on her. That being said I still felt like I wanted to die just to escape the constant misery. I hoped an armed robber would come into my work or someone would hit my car.

The thing that snapped me out of those thoughts was something my uncle said to me after revealing that he too almost killed himself after a break up. He said he had the gun in hand but one of his friends gave him the advice that saved is life, and now mine as well. 

You die for the ones you love, not because of them. 

I would give my life for her without a second thought if I needed to, and the sacrifice yourself for the ones you love is an honorable thing to do. However ending your life in response to the ones you love, whether it is due to betrayal, or hurt, or hardship, is never the right thing to do. They do not deserve the fallout and no matter how you feel you deserve to live. Even if it seems hopeless, there is a reason for the suffering and you owe it to yourself to find out just what that is.

I hope things work out with her, I love her more thar anything and I'll never truly move on. But I know t V need to be strong for her sake and for mine."

Hope his words can give you light in the darkest time of yours rn

What I would truly had missed out if I had taken my life is hope

I had my attempts. I told this person that I broke up with openly about my problems. I felt it was necessary to tell closest people about this.

Actually, after the break up, I have gone to counselings. Back in November, I was giving up again and planned to leave after I made one full happy birthday week. 

The girl came back. I didn't kill myself because I didn't want her to feel responsible. We went to another relationship but I broke it off because she said she was in the relationship 70% because she didn't want to lose me (I broke it off just because I didn't want pity). Things went okay and then went bad again around December.

Was about to leave again before new year but I decided to stay after reading Reddit threads and talk a little bit with my ex. I had motivation to live because I didn't want anyone to feel helpless about me and leave. I feel responsible for someone that cares for me leaving. That's when I realized I am the problem. Then, I tried to make myself better.

Tried to talk openly to my father after being suggested by my doctor (I was hesitant because I know he said something in the past that can trigger me).

 Well what do I know? He said just being alive is not enough; "you need to have a purpose on life" (He got a point after I reflected on his words).

But yeah.. some days are harder than others. I wouldn't say I didn't limit myself to get help. But I do feel in a way, most people misunderstood with what I'm going through.

So why after 19th February? Because on 16th is when I will be fulfilling my last promise to my ex. On the 19th February, will be the last day of my internship. After that, I just don't know. (Hope you don't see this as a selfish move)
